problem_statement: The paper frames the core problem as loading classical probability distributions into quantum states efficiently, especially for finance-relevant distributions. It also treats European call option pricing via quantum amplitude estimation as an application of that loading problem.
problem_statement_quotes: loading classical probability distributions into quantum states remains a major challenge.

This work extends quantum generative adversarial networks (qGANs) to overcome two critical limitations of early approaches: poor robustness to noise on near-term devices and limited capacity to model complex, multi-modal distributions.
The framework is further validated through European call option pricing via quantum amplitude estimation (QAE), achieving pricing errors below 1% on IBM’s 20-qubit superconducting systems.
classical_baseline: The paper compares against exact classical state preparation, which it says scales exponentially, and against prior qGANs with a baseline RY–CZ ansatz. For finance, it also compares against classical Monte Carlo and classical GAN baselines.
classical_baseline_quotes: exact preparation of an arbitrary n-qubit state from classical data requires O(2n) gates, which scales exponentially and undermines quantum advantage for large n.
the baseline variational ansatz (RY–CZ layers) struggles with multi-modal or correlated distributions, limiting expressivity.
classical_difficulty: The paper says the classical exact loading cost scales exponentially with the number of qubits, making it impractical for large systems. It also says prior qGANs are unstable under NISQ noise and that the baseline ansatz has limited expressivity for multi-modal or correlated distributions.
classical_difficulty_quotes: exact preparation of an arbitrary n-qubit state from classical data requires O(2n) gates, which scales exponentially and undermines quantum advantage for large n.
the baseline variational ansatz (RY–CZ layers) struggles with multi-modal or correlated distributions, limiting expressivity.
extraction_notes: Motivation is explicit in abstract and introduction; paper is strongly about qGAN data loading with finance applications.
